attr.title: RG-SMP
attr.desc: A compact 11-track sample drum machine for your handheld: browse WAV files recursively, assign one sample per track, and build 1-16-step patterns with accents, swing, ratchet rolls/flams, a 200-slot pattern library, 512-bar song chains with WAV export, a master effects chain, per-track mute and held R1 punch-in FX. Samples are loaded on demand; patterns reference their WAV paths directly. Built with C and SDL2 for 640x480 handhelds.
attr.inst: Ready to run. Put your own WAV sample folders under rgsmp/assets/wav (the port ships with a starter set).
